statBlock.name: Jackalwere
statBlock.description: A jackal with the power to take human form. Jackalweres waylay travelers and use their sleep gaze to capture victims for lamias.

sections.Languages: Common. It can't speak in jackal form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action it takes the form of a specific Medium human, a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or its true Small jackal form. Only its size can change its statistics. Its equipment keeps its form. When it dies, the jackalwere returns to its true form.
Keen Hearing and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on attacks against a creature if one or more of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Bite (jackal or hybrid form). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Scimitar (human or hybrid form). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Sleep Gaze. One creature the jackalwere can see within 30 ft. must make a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, magical sleep makes it Unconscious for 10 minutes, or until someone spends an action shaking it awake. A successful save makes the creature immune to this jackalwere's gaze for 24 hours. Undead and creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 193, with the global damage immunity wording from the 2018 errata.

statBlock.name: Kenku
statBlock.description: A wingless, feathered humanoid that communicates by reproducing sounds it has heard. A flock can use animal calls as signals.

sections.Languages: Understands Auran and Common. It speaks through Mimicry.
sections.Traits:
Ambusher. During the first round of combat, it has advantage on attack rolls against creatures it surprised.
Mimicry. It can reproduce sounds it has heard, including voices. A listener recognizes the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 194, with the Ambusher timing from the 2018 errata.

statBlock.name: Bullywug
statBlock.description: A frog-headed swamp raider. Bullywugs train giant frogs and bring captive trespassers before their self-styled rulers.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. It can speak in Bullywug to convey simple ideas to frogs and toads.
Swamp Camouflage. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in swamp terrain.
Standing Leap. It can long jump up to 20 ft. and high jump up to 10 ft. A running start is optional.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes one Bite and one melee Spear attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage with two hands in melee.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa
statBlock.description: An amphibious Underdark warrior with a net and an adhesive shield. Kuo-toa can bring deities into being through shared belief.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses any Invisible creature or creature on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint those that are moving.
Slippery. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to escape a grapple.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage with two hands in melee.
Net. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit leaves the target Restrained. A creature can spend an action to free itself or another creature with a successful DC 10 Strength check. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the AC 10 net destroys it and frees the target unharmed.
sections.Reactions: Sticky Shield. When a creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa catches the weapon with its shield. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw to keep the weapon from sticking. A stuck weapon is unusable. The wielder is Grappled while it is stuck if the wielder can't or won't release it. A creature can take an action and make a DC 11 Strength check to pull the weapon free.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Archpriest
statBlock.description: The ruler of a kuo-toa domain and a cleric of the god it demands its subjects worship. It grants spells to its whips and can withdraw that power.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses any Invisible creature or creature on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint those that are moving.
Slippery. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to escape a grapple.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Spellcasting:
The archpriest casts as a 10th-level cleric, using Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips at will: guidance, sacred flame, thaumaturgy.
1st level, 4 slots: detect magic, sanctuary, shield of faith.
2nd level, 3 slots: hold person, spiritual weapon.
3rd level, 3 slots: spirit guardians, tongues.
4th level, 3 slots: control water, divination.
5th level, 2 slots: mass cure wounds, scrying.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes two melee attacks.
Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 200, with the Unarmed Strike damage from the errata.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Monitor
statBlock.description: An enforcer who watches for dissent and carries out the archpriest's orders. Its unarmed strikes keep opponents from taking reactions.

sections.Armor: Natural armor with the monitor's Wisdom modifier added.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses any Invisible creature or creature on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint those that are moving.
Slippery. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to escape a grapple.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes one Bite attack and two Unarmed Strikes.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage. The target can't take reactions until the end of the monitor's next turn.
sections.Variant: The monitor uses the Whip's statistics with AC 13, CR 3 (700 XP), and the actions above. The variant removes Spellcasting.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), monitor variant p. 198 and base Whip profile p. 200.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Whip
statBlock.description: A priest who draws its magic from the archpriest's favor. A whip can pin a captive with its pincer staff while its allies close in.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses any Invisible creature or creature on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint those that are moving.
Slippery. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to escape a grapple.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Spellcasting:
The whip casts as a 2nd-level cleric, using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips at will: sacred flame, thaumaturgy.
1st level, 3 slots: bane, shield of faith.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes one Bite and one Pincer Staff attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Pincer Staff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14). While the grapple lasts, the whip can't use the staff against a different target.

statBlock.name: Winged Kobold
statBlock.description: Also called an urd, this kobold has leathery wings and uses high ledges to drop stones on intruders.

sections.Traits:
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on attacks against a creature if one or more of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Dropped Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, one target directly below the kobold. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
